label: token right after an early f (f at position 0 or 1)
explanation: Fires in the original phase on the input that immediately follows an f, but only when that f was original token 0 or 1 (i.e. at step 1 or 2). Strongest (near max, about 2.4) at step 1 when the sequence starts with f; this accounts for about 75% of activation mass. Weaker and more variable (0.05-0.9 of max) at step 2 after f at position 1. It does not fire after an f later in the sequence, after any other token, on the f itself, or in the delimiter/copy phases. Missed activations (about 2%) are near-zero blips, e.g. after a leading z or after f at position 2. False positives are mostly step-2 cases where the activation is zero.

issues: Systematic false-positive class at step 2: the feature stays silent after an f at position 1 when the first token is d, f, r, s, t or x (dev precision is 0.0 for each of these first tokens, about 560 steps per token). It is only partly active when the first token is i (0.76) or p (0.63). For every other first token, precision is 1.0. So the 3,700 test false positives are not just 'step-2 cases where activation is zero'. They come from a gate on the first token.
One consequence: 'f f X' sequences (f at both position 0 and position 1) never fire at step 2. The explanation's claim that the feature fires 'after an f at position 1' therefore overclaims.

Decomposition on the test split: t==1 & prev f has precision 1.0, recall 0.55 and mass 0.75. t==2 & prev f has precision 0.78, recall 0.43 and mass 0.25. The step-2 part is where the original predicate is imprecise.

The other claims hold. Activation is confined to the original phase (1 delimiter step and 9 copy steps out of 30,448, essentially zero mass). The max is about 2.44 at step 1 with a leading f. It never fires on the f itself or after later f's. The misses are about 700 near-zero blips (mostly step 1 after a leading z, about 0.00 of max). Mass recall is 0.9998.
skeptic.revised_label: token right after an early f: step 1 after a leading f (strong), or step 2 after f at position 1 unless the first token is d/f/r/s/t/x

final_label: token right after an early f: step 1 after a leading f (strong), or step 2 after f at position 1 unless the first token is d/f/r/s/t/x
